name: Ashley Zhang
source: A Korean-American who has only ever been pursued by boys due to her being half Korean, i.e. "yellow fever." She has grown to distrust the motivations of potential suitors as a result. However, she also has a strong desire to one day have a child, to the point where she despises birth control.
